fromAgent.description: Slug of the agent that passed the baton.

artifactId.description: Artifact that motivated the handoff (product_brief, module_map…).

status.description: This field is MUTABLE — it is the current state. Each transition also becomes an immutable `handoff.*` event in the log, which is where the history lives.

400.description: Invalid body. The `ValidationPipe` runs with `whitelist` and `forbidNonWhitelisted`, so an unknown field also fails.

401.description: No token, expired token, or invalid signature.

404.description: Project, session, or handoff not found.

429.description: Rate limit per user or per IP.
